title: Ted Serios' thoughtographs studied by Jule Eisenbud
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Ted Serios' thoughtographs studied by Jule Eisenbud, about 1960s at Chicago, Illinois, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The PK Man. Another example would be Ted Cerios, the famous thoughtgrapher who was a Chicago bellhop studied by Juel Eisenbud, the psychiatrist who produced these images on Polaroid film.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic claims, tells on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels of Ted Serios, a Chicago hotel bellhop in the 1960s. He says Serios made images appear on Polaroid instant film using only his mind, which he calls "thoughtographs", and that a psychiatrist named Jule Eisenbud studied him. If true, it would mean the mind can act directly on the physical world.
